title: American Honda Expands Recall of Honda Talon 1000 ROVs Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
summary: The vehicle's intake funnel band screw can loosen and enter the engine through the intake funnel and cause sudden engine failure. If this occurs, it can result in a loss of control, increasing the risk of a crash or injury. Units: About 34,000 (About 32,000 were previously recalled in March 2022).

title: BISSELL Recalls Cordless Multi-Surface Wet Dry Vacuums Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The circuit board inside the vacuum's battery pack can overheat and smoke, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 61,000 (In addition, about 4,300 were sold in Canada).

title: LG Electronics Recalls Free-Standing 86-Inch Smart Televisions and Stands Due to Serious Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The TV can become unstable while on the assembled stand, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in injuries or death to children and others. Units: About 52,000 (In addition, about 1,800 were sold in Canada and about 2,900 were sold in Mexico).

title: MI Windows and Doors Recalls Vinyl Single-Hung Impact Windows Due to Fall and Serious Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The tilt latch can cause the window opening control devices to malfunction, posing fall and serious injury hazards. Units: About 25,000.

title: Fisher-Price Reannounces Recall of 4.7 Million Rock 'n Play Sleepers; At Least Eight Deaths Occurred After Recall
summary: Infant fatalities have occurred in the Rock 'n Play Sleepers, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side while unrestrained, or under other circumstances. Units: About 4.7 million (The original recall was announced on April 12, 2019).

title: Kids2 Reannounces Recall of 694,000 Rocking Sleepers; Four Additional Deaths After Recall
summary: Infant fatalities have occurred in the Rocking Sleepers, after the infants rolled from their back to their stomach or side while unrestrained, or under other circumstances. Units: About 694,000 (The original recall was announced in April 2019).

title: P.J. Salvage Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled children's pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 2,650.

title: Polaris Recalls Sportsman and Scrambler 1000 S All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Electrostatic discharge outside the fuel tank can ignite fuel spills while refueling, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,800 (In addition, about 780 were sold in Canada).

title: Quality Bicycle Products Recalls Carbon Handlebars and Bicycles Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The recalled handlebars can crack where the brake/shift levers are installed and cause a crash, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 8,740 (In addition, about 350 were sold in Canada).

title: Properly Tied Recalls Children's Lounge Pants Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled children's sleepwear fails to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 1,960.

title: ZLINE Expands Recall of Gas Ranges to Include 48-inch Gas Ranges Due to Serious Risk of Injury or Death from Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
summary: The oven of the gas ranges can emit dangerous levels of carbon monoxide (CO) while in use, posing a serious risk of injury or death from carbon monoxide poisoning. Units: About 30,000 (including the 28,000 ZLINE 30 and 36-inch gas ranges recalled in December 2022).

title: Children's Pajama Sets Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard; Manufactured by Selfie Craft Company
summary: The children's pajama sets fail to meet flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 38,740.

title: Lifetime Brands Recalls Hot Chocolate Pots Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Williams-Sonoma
summary: The hot chocolate pots are mislabeled as microwave safe. If microwaved, the metallic paint on the pots can spark, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,700 (In addition, about 40 were sold in Canada).

title: Meguiar's Recalls Headlight Sealant Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The recalled headlight sealant contains low-viscosity hydrocarbons which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). title: Ross Stores Recalls Taylor and Finch Six-Wick Scented Candles Due to Fire and Injury Hazards
summary: The product can combust while lit causing the glass container to break, posing fire and injury hazards. Units: About 5,800.

title: Sakar International Recalls Multi-Purpose Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the positional stability and retention system requirements of the U.S. CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 33,100.

title: Vaenait Baby Recalls Children's Robes Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard
summary: The children's robes fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 2,400.

title: Vanessa Fire Tables Recalled Due to Fire Hazard; Imported by Ove Decors
summary: The gas hose can come into contact with the heat shield, melting the hose and igniting the fire table, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 470 (In addition, about 14 units were sold in Canada).
